unsupported.text: There is no sensor or indicator on the cup.

unsupported.fix: Stay within the eight-hour maximum and follow the supplied cleaning guidance.

unsupported.text: The eight-hour guideline assumes the cup is not overflowing, and on heavier days it may fill sooner than on lighter ones.

unsupported.text: No different wear time is specified for heavy flow, so check and empty more frequently if you suspect the cup is getting full.

unsupported.text: The eight-hour wear time may fit around a night's sleep for some people; follow the supplied instructions.

unsupported.text: Insertion and removal can take practice. The first few tries may feel awkward.

unsupported.text: If you prefer a product with a fixed, disposable design, a cup may not be your first choice — and that is fine.
